lockFileMaintenance.description: The shared preset takes :maintainLockFilesWeekly from config:best-practices; this block is declared after the extends so monthly wins. MINIMUM RELEASE AGE DOES NOT APPLY HERE, and cannot: Renovate delegates the refresh to the package manager, so a regenerated uv.lock may pull a transitive dependency published minutes ago. Renovate passes a cutoff to npm and to Poetry and has none for uv (renovatebot/renovate#41652), so the cooldown for this path is tool.uv.exclude-newer in pyproject.toml, held equal to the preset's minimumReleaseAge as the uv docs advise.
schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The docs site is not shipped in the Python package, so its updates are chores, not fixes. Without this Renovate labels npm dependency bumps `fix(deps)` - the React 19 PR arrived titled that way - and release-please files them under Bug Fixes in the changelog.

react and react-dom must move together: bumping one alone leaves the other's peer range unsatisfiable and fails the docs build. This is why the two split Dependabot PRs (#1, #2) were both permanently red.

PyDBML still calls pyparsing's pre-PEP8 escChar alias, which warns from 3.3 and dies under filterwarnings = ["error"]. Mirrors the cap in pyproject.toml; lift both together once PyDBML ships the snake_case API.
Docusaurus packages move as a set; a partial bump leaves the preset and core on different versions.
